dashboard.executive.ceo.title: CEO executive overview
dashboard.executive.ceo.confidenceHint: How far the figure can be relied on: high for system-derived data with at least 90% completeness, medium for self-reported data or 70-90% completeness, low below 70%.
dashboard.executive.ceo.slotHint.strateg: Strategic KPIs at or above their ratified target, among those with a verified measurement this period. Coverage is shown beside it; delivery of the supporting initiatives is shown separately and never counted as achievement.
dashboard.executive.ceo.slotHint.governa: Share of approved architecture decisions independently verified as implemented by their original deadline.
dashboard.executive.ceo.slotHint.deliver: Of the in-flight initiatives that reported, the share whose latest status report is on track on schedule, cost and scope, as of the end of the period. Reporting coverage is shown beside it.
dashboard.executive.ceo.slotHint.service: Digital share of government services and the automation level of eligible business processes, reported separately.
dashboard.executive.ceo.slotHint.value: Realised financial benefits confirmed by Finance. Planned savings are shown as a forecast only and are never counted as realised or used for ROI.
dashboard.executive.ceo.slotHint.decisio: Risks that need executive attention: open risks rated critical, or high and past their target date. Open and mitigated risks and pending governance decisions are shown beside it.
dashboard.executive.ceo.forecastNote_one: Forecast, not realised. {{count}} conflicting estimate is excluded; not tied to a fiscal year yet.
dashboard.executive.ceo.forecastNote_oth: Forecast, not realised. {{count}} conflicting estimates are excluded; not tied to a fiscal year yet.
dashboard.executive.ceo.footnote: Figures count only the records you are allowed to see. Targets and owners appear once each indicator has a target approved by its owner. A figure without an agreed source shows Not available, never zero.
